_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the TS3 Manager egg in pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: TS3 Manager
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: TS3 Manager is a web interface for managing TeamSpeak 3 servers through their ServerQuery. Open the server's address and sign in with a ServerQuery login.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# TS3 Manager: downloads the release for the chosen version from GitHub and
# checks its checksum. It's one program, ts3-manager; nothing else is
# touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "This server's CPU ($(uname -m)) isn't supported." ;;
esac

[ "$arch" = amd64 ] || fail "TS3 Manager is only built for x86-64 CPUs, and this server is $arch."
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=latest
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then tag="v${want#v}"; fi
tag=$(gh-release tag joni1802/ts3-manager "$tag") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.2.6, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"
name="ts3-manager-linux-x64-v$version"

if [ -x ts3-manager ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "TS3 Manager $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading TS3 Manager $version"
    gh-release download joni1802/ts3-manager "$tag" "$name" ts3-manager
    chmod +x ts3-manager
    echo "$version" > .raptor-version
fi
# The old egg's name for it.
rm -f start_ts3-manager
echo "Installed TS3 Manager $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The TS3 Manager version to install, such as 2.2.6, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Allowed servers
variables.description: The TeamSpeak servers it may connect to, as addresses separated by commas. Leave it empty to allow any.
